shared_elements: schematic human figures shown frontally/in profile with outstretched arms
small repeated signs/marks arranged in rows
curved arc line spanning above figures
justification: Both surfaces depict schematic human figures with extended arms and small repeated incised signs, but that is about as generic as figurative rock/stone imagery gets. A shows a formal, framed pair of standing figures with elaborate headgear, staffs and a register of script beneath an arched canopy, while B shows scattered boats with crew-strokes and tiny stick figures with no framing, register or symmetry — the organising schemes have nothing specific in common.
